newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa announces first franchise partner.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa announces first franchise partner.

text.p: German airline Lufthansa AG said on Tuesday it had found its first partner, Augsburg Airways, for its new co-operation concept, Team Lufthansa.
Lufthansa said in a statement that Augsburg Airways will operate, at its own cost, three domestic German routes, flying from Munich under the franchise name Team Lufthansa.
Safety and quality standards are set by Lufthansa under the terms of the franchise and the flights, with Lufthansa flight numbers, will start on October 27 as part of the winter flight plan.
Lufthansa said that other regional routes in Germany and in Europe would be operated under the co-operation agreement in due course.
